title: ShopMart — Stored XSS in Product Reviews
objective: Product reviews are public and rendered with no sanitization. A store admin periodically moderates new reviews — get your payload to run in their session.

verifier.condition: A stored product review's payload executes as real JavaScript when a privileged (admin) moderation session later views the product page, and exfiltrates that session's page-specific token to /collect.

weakness: Product review text is stored and later rendered unencoded to a moderator, so stored script runs in a privileged session.
seededData: Two products with seeded reviews; one admin moderator session.
solutionHint: Leave a review on the Mechanical Keyboard product page. Whatever you type in the review text appears on the page exactly as typed — including for whoever moderates it later.
